strict_scale_note: SCENARIO_TOO_SMALL for large_system_strict without padding. Natural hop/resume interpreter is a few hundred reachable LOC plus a tiny reactor tree; cloning dummy modules or Jenkins XML would only inflate the gate.

root_cause_clusters.RC1_RESUME_DURABILITY: Resume ignores durable journal results and rebuilds from checkout.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_LIBRARY_PIN: Shared-library resolution loads the newest on-disk version instead of the pipeline pin.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_AGENT_LABELS: Stage kind is not enforced against agent labels, so maven work can run on docker-only nodes.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_INCREMENTAL_FP: Content-hash fingerprints do not gate module skip, so unchanged modules always rebuild.
root_cause_clusters.RC5_STASH_HOP: Named stash is dropped or not required across the maven-to-docker hop.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_ARCHIVE_REDACT: Pipeline secret env values are written into the run archive.

defects.observable_failure: resume clears completed_stages and replays checkout.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Skipping only scm still reruns a durable compile.

defects.observable_failure: resume mints a new run_id instead of continuing b-1842.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Keeping the id but wiping stage records still rebuilds everything.

defects.observable_failure: illegal test results on docker-07 stay durable across resume.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Retrying only failed_module leaves common marked ok on an illegal agent.

defects.observable_failure: compile.ok pre-crash markers are overwritten on resume.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Copying markers aside then rebuilding still spends a full compile hop.

defects.observable_failure: platform-lib 1.5.0 is loaded although the pin is 1.4.2.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hardcoding 1.4.2 in the journal without reading the pin breaks the next bump.

defects.observable_failure: library resolve sorts directory names and takes the last semver.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Picking the first directory still ignores the exact pin.

defects.observable_failure: incremental flag comes from 1.5.0 so skip never engages.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Forcing incremental true while still loading 1.5.0 leaves redact_secrets false.

defects.observable_failure: select_agent returns docker-07 for kind maven.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Preferring linux label alone still admits the docker-only node.

defects.observable_failure: a maven stage recorded agent_labels without maven.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Relabeling docker-07 to include maven in the inventory falsifies the pool.

defects.observable_failure: missing maven label still marks compile ok.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Catching the error and continuing on docker hides the refuse-closed rule.

defects.observable_failure: second run rebuilds every module although hashes match.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Skipping all modules including those whose deps just rebuilt hides downstream invalidation.

defects.observable_failure: editing web still skips web because skip ignores upstream skip-only.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rebuilding every module after any edit works but breaks incremental.

defects.observable_failure: fingerprint files are never written after a successful module.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing fingerprints without consulting them on the next run is a no-op.

defects.observable_failure: resume drops reactor-classes before the docker hop.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Recreating an empty stash name lets package proceed without artifacts.

defects.observable_failure: package succeeds when the named stash map is empty.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking only that the stash key exists still allows modules=[].

defects.observable_failure: docker package writes image.ok without unstash.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Always requiring stash on scm as well blocks checkout.

defects.observable_failure: NEXUS_PASSWORD appears in var/archive/b-1842.log.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deleting the archive file fails the operator evidence path.

defects.observable_failure: BUILD_TOKEN is copied into the env dump verbatim.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Redacting only PASSWORD suffix leaves TOKEN values exposed.

defects.observable_failure: redact_secrets from 1.5.0 is false so *** is never applied.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hardcoded *** without loading 1.4.2 still fails the pin journal check.

defects.observable_failure: unknown pipe verbs rewrite journal status.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Exiting 1 after a partial status write still mutates state.
